param.name: feature_type
param.dialogReference: Select a built-in object type for SAM3 extraction, or choose Custom and provide a Custom SAM3 Text Prompt.

param.name: workflow
param.dialogReference: Choose Feature Extraction, Embedding Similarity, or Feature Classification. Feature Classification assigns user-defined example classes to supplied or extracted target features.

param.name: in_target_features
param.dialogReference: Optional target polygons for Feature Classification. When supplied, feature extraction is skipped and these features receive the class with the strongest overlapping similarity evidence.

param.name: in_aoi
param.displayname: Area of Interest Polygon (Optional; Overrides Extent)
param.dialogReference: Provide a polygon to limit processing. Otherwise, set the Processing Extent environment.

param.name: in_example_points
param.dialogReference: Provide representative points. Each class in a Feature Classification run needs at least six points that intersect unique embedding cells.

param.name: example_class_field
param.dialogReference: Select the example-point field containing the labels to assign, such as Green Roof or Brick Roof. Used only by Feature Classification.

param.name: out_features
param.dialogReference: Output extracted features, similar embedding cells, or classified target features. Feature Classification adds AUTO_CLASS and CLASS_COV_PCT.

param.name: out_embeddings
param.dialogReference: Derived embedding cells used for similarity analysis.

param.name: out_similar_features
param.dialogReference: Derived embedding cells matching the supplied examples.

dataIdInfo.idPurp: Creates features from imagery and classifies image similarity using user-defined example classes.
dataIdInfo.idAbs: Use Feature Extraction to find a named object type with SAM3. Use Embedding Similarity to find locations matching representative examples. Use Feature Classification to classify supplied target features or features extracted by SAM3 using user-defined example classes.
